English internal edition — 2026-09-25

  • App package version: 0.1.0; capture commit: a0da26137f1046258243681bd1a30de870f00289.
  • Added student, lecturer, quick-help, troubleshooting, glossary, and support guides, with current English desktop and phone screenshots made from synthetic accounts.
  • Added a searchable static docs site and a tagged, bookmarked English PDF generated from the same source.
  • Added numbered captions for every figure, grouped website contents with a phone page outline, and a two-column PDF contents page with chapter numbers.
  • Before public distribution: real support contact and docs URL, live camera and assessment-recovery walkthroughs, first-time reader testing, Bahasa Malaysia translation and localized screenshots, and formal PDF accessibility review.

The public edition must state the matching Easy2U release or commit and the date of the final UI walkthrough here.
